title: Synergistic effect of ZIF-8 and NiCo2O4 toward efficient performance for urea electrooxidation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,39616-39629
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07606D, Paper

Fowzia S. Alamro, Mahmoud A. Hefnawy, Nada S. Al-Kadhi, Hoda A. Ahmed, Shymaa S. Medany
A hybrid NiCo2O4-ZIF-8 nanocomposite was developed as an efficient and stable electrocatalyst for urea electrooxidation, combining high porosity, enhanced conductivity, and abundant active sites.
